use_GTBoxSubOne_GLIP_transform: use GTBoxSubOne_GLIP transform to subtract 1 from x2 and y2 coordinates of ground truth bounding boxes
use_GTBoxSubOne_GLIP_with_numpy: use GTBoxSubOne_GLIP transform on numpy array bounding boxes to adjust endpoint coordinates by subtracting 1
use_GTBoxSubOne_GLIP_with_HorizontalBoxe: use GTBoxSubOne_GLIP transform with HorizontalBoxes to adjust bounding box endpoint coordinates in detection pipelines
use_RandomFlip_GLIP_flip: use RandomFlip_GLIP to flip images and bounding boxes horizontally with an additional x-coordinate subtraction of 1
use_RandomFlip_GLIP_masks_segs: use RandomFlip_GLIP to flip ground truth masks and semantic segmentation maps along with images and bounding boxes
